### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, touching **38** documentable anchor(s).

**36** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **38** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1d621cbbda45dd06bc5c79f61e2992bb6a102259` — the merge of head `6be0aea6a64d61bac1d2831d33da398c967deee7` into base `dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1d621cbbda45dd06bc5c79f61e2992bb6a102259 && git checkout 1d621cbbda45dd06bc5c79f61e2992bb6a102259
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050 6be0aea6a64d61bac1d2831d33da398c967deee7 && git checkout -B drift-repro dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050 && git merge --no-ff 6be0aea6a64d61bac1d2831d33da398c967deee7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs dfafae81324e508cc666171d3385a15b89f31050` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6be0aea6a64d61bac1d2831d33da398c967deee7`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.test.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-customization-pair-install.test.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-override-gate.test.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-extension-field-suffix.test.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts, packages/cli/test/package-install-customization-pair.test.ts, packages/cli/test/package-export.test.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/unmanaged-install.ts, packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts, packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts, packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-reinstall-custom-pair.dogfood.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md

Face, read off the committed tree (10 files, `gh api .../pulls/30207/files`): no `packages/spec/src/**` path, no governed path (`record-recognisers.mjs --paths` on the file list derives no face and defers to the changeset's `Clause-②:` line, which reads `no` with no arm). The review is owed to the dev's measured open_question (a possible narrowing arm), so it is served at this tier with ④ and the narrowing-face floor: every non-prose path of the diff is in Scope. The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); the implementing identity is the claim's branch.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff makes, each judged:

1. **Pair id routed off the managed path** (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, `handleInstall` after step 1d', `customizationBasePackageId(manifestId) !== null` ⇒ `installCustomizationPair`). Correct and the card's fix: ADR-0146 D3 says the pair is "an ordinary writable package", D2 that its items are stored rows a served read reads (`protocol-served-overrides.ts#listServedOverrides` selects `package_id = pair, state: 'active'`, card comment 6633535319). Registering it as code (`manifest.register` + ledger + `syncSchemas`) was never the declared contract. Ordered after 1c' (dependency check, so a missing base is refused 422 before the pair branch), 1c'' (`__c` reservation), 1e (install mode), 1d (unrunnable code), 1d' (withheld maps): the pre-existing refusals still apply to a pair body. Judged right.

2. **Pair body keys with no item form refused 422 `VALIDATION_ERROR`** (`marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.ts#planCustomizationPairInstall`: a key not in `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, not `viewItems`, not `objectExtensions`, carrying content, whose `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` entry is `code`/`uncopyable`/`envelope`/`converted` or absent). Read against what the export writes (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts#assemblePackageManifest`: the `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` collections minus `datasources`/`emailTemplates`, `viewItems`, `objectExtensions`, then `id`/`name`/`version`/`label?`/`namespace`/`dependencies`/`withheldMaps?`): every key a pair export writes is admitted (`id`/`namespace` = `base`, `name`/`version` = `identity`, `label`/`withheldMaps`/`data`/`installModes` = `door`). `translations` is not in `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` (`manifest-collection-spelling.ts`, ends at `books`) and is `converted` in the table, so it is refused as the test pins; the export never writes it for a pair. Not a narrowing of a published accept set: `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` has no request/response schema in `packages/spec/src/api/**` (grep: only ledger prose and `package-lifecycle.zod.ts` comments name the route), and the refused bodies installed nothing that worked (0 overrides served, pair read-only, measured in 6633535319). Judged right; `Clause-②: no` holds.

3. **Pair inside a multi-package artifact refused 422 (`details.pairs`)**. The published bundle flow (`GET /packages/export`, `PackageExportBundleSchema`) installs entries one at a time, `{ manifest: entry }` (`package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts` lines 202, 412), so no published consumer sends a pair inside `packages[]`. The refusal lists every pair, before any write. Judged right, not a narrowing of a published path.

4. **Pair manifest refused 400 `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID` when it lacks the explicit namespace or the base dependency** (`customizationPairManifestRefusal`, `protocol-customization-package.ts` line 206). The same predicate is asked on `main` by `installPackage` (`protocol-package-install.ts:249`), `POST /packages` (`runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:1719`) and the duplicate door (`protocol-package-commits.ts:241`); install-local asking it is the declared contract pulled back, not a new requirement. Current exports carry both keys (`PackageExportManifestSchema.namespace` / `.dependencies`). Judged right.

5. **Pair already read-only refused 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` before the ensure door** (`isWritablePackage(ql, manifestId)` from `package-writability.ts:73`: `engine.manifests.has` first, then `READ_ONLY_PACKAGE_SCOPES` by manifest scope, else writable). The three remedies are derived from `this.ledger.has`, `this.bootUserCodeIds`, and manifest `scope`; the ensure door would otherwise answer `201 created: true, writable: false` (dev measured). Judged right.

6. **Writes through `saveMetaItem`** with `mode: 'publish'`, `packageId: pair`, `actor: userId`, in `loadOrder` (`SaveMetaItemRequestSchema`, `protocol.zod.ts:1103`: `publish` writes the `active` row; `protocol-save.ts#saveMetaItemUnaudited` line 498/1651 `state: 'active'`). The save door's own judges run on every item: `isWritablePackage` (line 1881, `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`), `overrideWriteVerdict`/`refusePackagedBaseOverride` (the D2 declaration and closure), `objectExtensionItemRefusal` (line 1197, an `object_extension` named by its target, as the planner names it). So the dev-flagged gap in the install-time gate (`overrideWriteItemsOf` walks `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` keys only, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, and so not `viewItems`) is closed by the save door for a pair. Judged right.

7. **Answer shape**: a pair answer carries `customizationPair { basePackageId, packageId, created, writable }`, `writtenCount`, `written`, `note`, optional `seeded`/`withheldMaps`, and no `hotLoaded`/`storageDir`. Public-surface reading: `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `exports` is `.` only, whose entry (`src/index.ts`) exports `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin` and `MarketplaceInstallLocalPluginConfig`; the route answers `c.json(...)` untyped, so no exported type reaches the body. `@objectstack/cli` `exports` (`.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`) reach `PackageInstallCommand` (an oclif `Command` class, no response type on it). No spec response schema exists. Nothing published is widened; no new `ErrorCode` is minted (`RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` are ledger rows; `VALIDATION_ERROR` is `errors.zod.ts:55`). Judged right; `Clause-②: no` without an arm. A `no (narrowing)` arm would be BREAKING under AGENTS.md step 3 (ADR-0087 marker, migration) for shapes that never produced a working install: not warranted.

8. **CLI** (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`): prints the pair answer; a pair id answered without `customizationPair` (older runtime) prints an error naming `DELETE .../install-local/{id}`, upgrade, restart, and exits 1. Correct reading of the mixed-version matrix; an older CLI against a new runtime prints the managed success lines (benign: the install did land). Judged right.

9. **`Metadata-protocol: none`** holds (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3): no spec key, value or type added, removed or re-meant; the manifest requirement in item 4 is already the published predicate; the door refusals are install behavior, not authoring protocol.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/30106-install-custom-pair-into-writable-pair.md`: `@objectstack/cloud-connection: patch`, `@objectstack/cli: patch`, both released (`package.json` has no `private`). Kind `none` ⇒ `patch` is the level step 3 prescribes; both line-initial declarations present and matching the PR body. No `content/docs/releases/` edit, no file outside the card (`packages/qa/dogfood/**` untouched, the two pair dogfood files pass at head per the dev's report). Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_question, Clause-② re-check (A keep `no` / B `yes (narrowing)`)**: A. Grounds in ① items 2, 3, 4, 7. B's spelling is also malformed under step 3 (the arm pairs as `no (narrowing)`), and the arm is BREAKING, which the facts do not support: nothing a consumer could rely on is taken away.
- **Cached-manifest location not keyed by `OS_HOME`** (`LocalManifestSource` default `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages`): out of this card; a pair no longer writes one. Follow-up card owed (dev's out_of_scope class a); not a defect of this PR.
- **`engine.manifests` keeps an uninstalled id until restart**: read in `package-writability.ts:77`; the 409 remedy names the restart; the dogfood "stale code pair" sequence was measured. Out-of-scope class a, not a defect of this PR.
- **Pair export omits `emailTemplates` and translation items**: read in `assemblePackageManifest` (`exportPluralKeys` filter). Those overrides do not round-trip today; a card on the export side, not this door. Noted.
- **`--install-mode unmanaged` on a pair takes the unmanaged copy path**: only when the pair manifest declares `installModes` including `unmanaged`, which the ensure door never writes and the export never adds (6633535319: `INSTALL_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED` otherwise). Noted, not a defect here.
- **Authorization of the pair write**: install-local's route requires `manage_metadata` (`INSTALL_LOCAL_CAPABILITY`, plugin line 377, checked at 5392); the ensure door's docblock leaves the walled-posture judgment to the HTTP door. A managed install already changes environment-wide state under the same capability, so the pair path widens no permission boundary. Judged, not a defect.
- Observation, not must-fix: a pre-fix ledgered pair whose boot `manifest.register` failed (the lenient `hotLoaded: false` path) reads writable, so the new path writes rows and leaves the stale ledger entry, which a later boot may register as code again. Pre-fix state only; the 409 remedy (DELETE, restart) clears it. Suggest a follow-up card: refuse or auto-remove a ledger entry for a pair id at step 3.
- Observation: the answer's `version` echoes the export's `version`; the target pair's row keeps the ensure door's `0.1.0` or its existing version. Informational.
- Check-runs at the head when read: 21 success, 13 skipped, 12 in progress (Test Core 1-8, four Lint jobs). Landing waits on all green; this record does not substitute for that read.

### ④ Design judgment

Against ADR-0146 D2/D3 and the card's acceptance:

- **Target serves the overrides / customizations read lists them**: every item becomes a `sys_metadata` row of the pair in `active` state through the save door a Studio edit takes (① item 6); `listServedOverrides` reads exactly those rows. Pinned at the route (`marketplace-install-local-customization-pair-install.test.ts` "writes every item through the save door", asserting the exact `saveMetaItem` calls, `register`/`syncSchemas` never called, no ledger file) and measured e2e in the PR body (`overrides: 2`, both labels served across two restarts). Holds.
- **Pair stays writable**: nothing enters `engine.manifests`, the ledger or the cached-manifest directory for the pair id; the answer carries `writable: true` only after the ensure door answered it; `writable !== true` is refused 409. Measured `ensure writable: true`, a further save 200. Holds.
- **Failure is not reported as success**: a refused save answers the save's status and code (`resolveThrownHttpError`, `thrown-http-error.ts:225`, reads `.status` then `.statusCode`), naming the item and path; refusal tests assert `status` (422/409/400/503) and `code` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `PLUGIN_MANIFEST_INVALID`, `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`) per the ADR-0112 envelope; the CLI's non-OK path prints `status` and `code` and exits 1. Holds.
- **Rollback**: a pair this install created is deleted through `deletePackage({ packageId, actor })` (`protocol.zod.ts:1681` `failedCount`); a non-zero `failedCount` or a thrown delete is logged at `error` and said in the answer; a pre-existing pair is kept with `details.written`/`details.notWritten`, every item re-saved on the next run. Partial publish into a pre-existing pair is disclosed, not hidden. Holds.
- **Nothing registered as code any more**: the three pre-existing tests that pinned `registered === [PAIR]` now pin `registered === []` with the saves named; the install path's `installCustomizationPair` returns before 1f/2a-2e's register, ledger write and `syncSchemas`. Holds.
- **Refusals before any write**: planner, override gate 2d, field-patch check 2e, manifest predicate, read-only pre-check, door presence (503) all precede the ensure call; the ensure door itself writes only through `installPackage` and is idempotent (`PAIR_FLIGHTS`). Holds.
- **Narrowing against the published spec on `main`**: the refused bodies and the bundled pair take no declared capability away at the consumer; they make D2/D3's own posture real at this door. The one-item-per-identity rule uses the save door's own key (`itemDiscriminator`, `(name, locale)` for `email_template`), so the planner and the row store agree.

No must-fix found.

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · head `6be0aea6a64d61bac1d2831d33da398c967deee7` · card #30106 (claim 6646484259) · 2026-11-05T02:28Z

- **Shape:** draft PR to `main`, author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay `pr_create`), attribution block then `Fixes #30106` on its own line; no other open card number sits next to a closing keyword. 10 files, +1325 −40 (below the 3000-line human-merge threshold). No governed path, no `packages/spec/src/**` path ⇒ not Tier H; the seat lands it.
- **Premise measured:** the dev confirmed the seat's assumption (the old path registered the pair as code and wrote no `sys_metadata` row) and found the pair also turned read-only; fix and pins in the PR body.
- **Gates (check-runs on this head):** 48 runs, 35 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed. `Lint & Repo Gates` success, `TypeScript Type Check` success. The 13 skips are path-gated UI/docs jobs, opt-in harnesses, push-only dogfood and the schedule gate; `check-expected-skips.mjs` could not run in this container (its `yaml` dependency is not installed), so the skip roster was read by name, not by the tool.
- **Contract review:** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, record 6647885067 on this head. `Clause-②: no` stands (no published schema or exported type reaches the install-local body or answer); `Metadata-protocol: none` stands; changeset `patch` on both released packages, consistent.
- **Prose read against the diff:** the changeset's "Before", "Now", "Refusals, nothing written", "A save refused part-way" and "The CLI" bullets; each matches the code and tests.
- **Accepted deviations:** the file surface grew from the claim's `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` to the door it hands off to, `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-*` (the actual install door). In the same package family and in the claim's "and the install door it calls"; no `packages/spec`.
- **Out of scope:** filed #30215 (an uninstalled package keeps reading read-only until a restart) and #30217 (the cached-manifest directory follows the working directory, not `OS_HOME`). Noted, not filed (read from code, not measured): pair export omits `emailTemplates` and translation items; `--install-mode unmanaged` on a pair; `overrideWriteItemsOf` not reading `viewItems` (covered at write time by the save door, per the review).
- **Writes:** api_writes 2, `mcp_calls` 5, all reads.
- **Landing:** `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` through the relay.
